name: metronome
description: Keep a beat, calculate note times, and plan tempo practice.

interface.longDescription:
Beatwise Metronome helps musicians plan tempo practice with an online metronome, tap tempo and a bpm counter in the chat. Set a 120 bpm metronome, choose accents and subdivisions, or build a bar-based tempo ramp. Use the beat row with sound or for silent practice.

The tempo calculator converts bpm to ms and rhythmic cycle hertz for whole through sixty-fourth notes, including dotted notes and triplets. Use it as a delay time calculator, compare reverb pre-delay suggestions, reverse a known note duration into beats per minute, or calculate bar and song length. BPM means quarter notes per minute. Italian tempo markings are approximate ranges that can overlap.

Plan a metronome for practice with a start tempo, target tempo, a BPM or percent step and minutes per stage. Preview the ladder and download it as CSV.

Limits: 20–400 quarter-note BPM, 1–16 beats per bar, 1000 ramp stages and 200 practice stages. Numeric inputs accept up to three decimal places. The widget runs only while it is on the screen. Audio timing depends on the device. No recording and no pitch detection.
defaultPrompt: Open a 120 bpm metronome in 4/4 with eighths and accents [2,1,1,1].
Convert a 250 ms straight eighth note into quarter-note BPM.
Plan tempo practice from 80 to 120 BPM in 5 BPM steps, with 2 minutes at each step.

positive.prompt: Open a 120 bpm metronome in 4/4 with eighths and accents [2,1,1,1].
positive.expected_behavior: 120 quarter-note BPM; 4/4, eighths. Quarter note: 500.000000 ms; signature beat: 500.000000 ms; subdivision: 250.000000 ms. Accent pattern: 2, 1, 1, 1 (0 silent, 1 normal, 2 accented). Press Start in the widget. The widget runs only while it is on the screen. Audio timing depends on the device. No recording and no pitch detection.

positive.prompt: Calculate note milliseconds and hertz at 120 quarter-note BPM in 4/4 for a 32-bar song.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 120.000000 quarter-note BPM, 500.000000 ms per quarter and 2000.000000 ms per bar, with a note-duration table. The song is 64.000000 seconds.

positive.prompt: Convert a 250 ms straight eighth note into quarter-note BPM.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 120.000000 quarter-note BPM, 500.000000 ms per quarter and 2000.000000 ms per bar, with a note-duration table.

positive.prompt: Plan tempo practice from 80 to 120 BPM in 5 BPM steps, with 2 minutes at each step.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 9 stages, 2 minutes per stage and 18.000 total minutes, with the ladder and CSV download.

positive.prompt: Open a triplet metronome in 3/4 from 80 to 100 BPM, adding 5 BPM after each 2 completed bars.
positive.expected_behavior: 80 quarter-note BPM; 3/4, triplets. Quarter note: 750.000000 ms; signature beat: 750.000000 ms; subdivision: 250.000000 ms. Accent pattern: 2, 1, 1 (0 silent, 1 normal, 2 accented). Ramp 80 to 100 BPM, 5 BPM after 2 completed bars; holds at target. Press Start in the widget. The widget runs only while it is on the screen. Audio timing depends on the device. No recording and no pitch detection.

negative.description: Do not call a tool: recording and pitch detection are outside scope.
negative.prompt: Record my guitar and tell me if the notes are in tune.

negative.description: Do not call a tool: song analysis requires audio detection, which is outside scope.
negative.prompt: Find the beats per minute of my uploaded song automatically.

negative.description: Do not call a tool: the widget cannot run unattended while off screen.
negative.prompt: Keep a metronome playing after I close the chat.

publication.release_notes: Live metronome with accents, subdivisions, tap tempo and tempo ramps; note-time calculations and practice ladder CSV downloads.

pl-PL.subtitle: Metronom i czasy nut
pl-PL.description: Metronom z akcentami, podziałami rytmu i tempem wyznaczanym stukaniem. Przeliczaj BPM na czasy nut, planuj stopniową zmianę tempa i pobieraj plan ćwiczeń w CSV. BPM oznacza ćwierćnuty na minutę. Widget działa tylko na ekranie; dźwięk zależy od urządzenia. Bez nagrywania i rozpoznawania wysokości dźwięku.

de-DE.subtitle: Metronom und Notendauern
de-DE.description: Metronom mit Akzenten, Unterteilungen und Tap-Tempo. Berechne Notendauern aus BPM, steigere das Tempo taktweise und lade Übungspläne als CSV herunter. BPM bedeutet Viertelnoten pro Minute. Das Widget läuft nur auf dem Bildschirm; das Audiotiming hängt vom Gerät ab. Keine Aufnahme oder Tonhöhenerkennung.

es-ES.subtitle: Metrónomo y tiempos de notas
es-ES.description: Metrónomo con acentos, subdivisiones y tempo por pulsaciones. Convierte BPM en duraciones de notas, cambia el tempo por compases y descarga planes de práctica en CSV. BPM significa negras por minuto. El widget funciona mientras está en pantalla; la precisión del audio depende del dispositivo. Sin grabación ni detección de tono.

fr-FR.subtitle: Métronome et durées de notes
fr-FR.description: Métronome avec accents, subdivisions et tempo par frappes. Calculez les durées de notes à partir des BPM, modifiez le tempo par mesures et téléchargez un plan de pratique en CSV. BPM signifie noires par minute. Le widget fonctionne à l’écran ; la précision sonore dépend de l’appareil. Sans enregistrement ni détection de hauteur.

ja-JP.subtitle: メトロノームと音符の時間
ja-JP.description: アクセント、細分化、タップテンポに対応したメトロノーム。BPMから音符の長さを計算し、小節ごとにテンポを変え、練習計画をCSVでダウンロードできます。BPMは1分あたりの四分音符の数です。ウィジェットは画面表示中のみ動作し、音のタイミングは端末に依存します。録音や音高検出には対応していません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Metrônomo e duração de notas
pt-BR.description: Metrônomo com acentos, subdivisões e tempo por toques. Converta BPM em duração de notas, mude o andamento por compassos e baixe planos de prática em CSV. BPM significa semínimas por minuto. O widget funciona enquanto está na tela; o tempo do áudio depende do dispositivo. Sem gravação nem detecção de altura.
